entities.summary: Second Republic, a political institution in Italy during Years of Lead and Mafia Wars (1992–1994). Grew from Judges Giovanni Falcone and Paolo Borsellino assassinated by the Mafia and Bologna train station bombing — deadliest terrorist attack in Italian history. Led to the emergence of Tangentopoli and Political Upheaval.
